# 💛 JavaScript Runtime & Systems Mastery Track

Welcome to the **JavaScript Runtime & Systems Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering V8 engine execution, the Event Loop (microtasks vs macrotasks), prototypal inheritance, closures, memory leaks, and modern Node.js streams.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-node-runtime` | Node.js & V8 Runtime | V8 engine, Ignition byte-code interpreter, TurboFan JIT compiler |
| `01-basics-variables-and-hoisting` | Hoisting & Scope | `var`, `let`, `const`, Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ), execution context |
| `02-primitive-types-and-coercion` | Type Coercion & Symbols | Implicit coercion (`==` vs `===`), `Symbol.for`, `BigInt`, IEEE 754 float traps |
| `03-objects-prototypes-and-proto` | Prototypal Inheritance | `[[Prototype]]`, `Object.prototype`, `Object.create()`, property descriptors |
| `04-arrays-and-functional-methods` | Arrays & V8 Packed Elements | `map`, `filter`, `reduce`, `flatMap`, V8 SMI / Double / Packed arrays |
| `05-functions-closures-and-scope` | Lexical Closures | Scope chains, closure memory footprint, IIFE, currying |
| `06-this-keyword-and-binding` | The `this` Keyword | Default, implicit, explicit binding (`call`, `apply`, `bind`), lexical `this` |
| `07-classes-and-inheritance` | ES6+ Classes & Private Fields | Prototypes under the hood, `#private` properties, `super()`, static blocks |
| `08-destructuring-rest-and-spread` | Destructuring & Cloning | Nested destructuring, rest/spread, shallow vs structured clone (`structuredClone`) |
| `09-iterators-and-generators` | Iteration Protocol & Generators | `Symbol.iterator`, `yield*`, generator state machines, custom iterables |
| `10-async-callbacks-promises-async-await` | Promises & Async/Await | `Promise` states, `.then()` chaining, `Promise.allSettled`, top-level await |
| `11-event-loop-and-microtasks` | Event Loop Mechanics | Call stack, Microtasks (`process.nextTick`, Promises) vs Macrotasks (`setTimeout`, `setImmediate`) |
| `12-error-handling-custom-errors` | Error Architecture | `try/catch/finally`, custom `Error` classes, `Error.captureStackTrace` |
| `13-modules-commonjs-vs-esm` | Module Formats | CommonJS (`require`) vs ESM (`import`), live bindings, dynamic `import()` |
| `14-memory-management-and-gc` | V8 Memory & Garbage Collection | Scavenge (New Space), Mark-Sweep-Compact (Old Space), memory leak debugging |
| `15-dom-and-browser-apis` | Web APIs & Event Delegation | Event bubbling & capturing, passive listeners, `AbortController`, `fetch` API |
| `16-testing-with-node-test-runner` | Native Node Test Runner | `node:test`, `node:assert/strict`, test suites, mocks |
| `17-node-streams-and-buffers` | Streams & Binary Buffers | `Buffer` allocations, Readable/Writable/Transform streams, `stream.pipeline` |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 JS gotchas (Event loop execution order, hoisting, `this` traps) |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.js` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.js` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.js` — Complete reference solution.

## 🎯 The 4 Binding Rules
1. **Default Binding**: Global object (or `undefined` in strict mode).
2. **Implicit Binding**: Context object before the dot (`obj.method()`).
3. **Explicit Binding**: `.call()`, `.apply()`, `.bind()`.
4. **`new` Binding**: Fresh object instance created by constructor.
- **Arrow Functions**: Do not have their own `this`; they inherit lexically from enclosing scope.
